title: Unique gluing for a localizing module presheaf on a principal affine cover
statement: Let $T$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $P$ a presheaf of $\mathcal O_T$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and $W$ an affine open. Assume for every $a\in\Gamma(T,W)$ the restriction $P(W)\to P(D(a))$, with scalars restricted to $\Gamma(T,W)$, is module localization at powers of $a$. Let $s\subseteq\Gamma(T,W)$ satisfy $W=\bigcup_{a\in s}D(a)$. Every family of elements in $P(D(a))$ compatible under restriction to every affine open mapping into two cover members has a unique amalgamation in $P(W)$.

source.place: Schemes, Lemma 01HV, label lemma-spec-sheaves, (2), (4), (5); associated module sheaf and its localization sections.

proof.text: Use localization linear equivalences to the principal sections of the associated module sheaf. Bundle both overlap restriction maps as linear maps over Gamma(T,W). Localization extensionality gives naturality because the endomorphism given by multiplication by ab is a unit, and therefore so are multiplication by a and b. All maps agree on the original module.

The affine span criterion converts the cover to a cover of Spec Gamma(T,W). Transfer the matching family, glue in the associated module sheaf, and use its bijective global constant-section map to recover an element of P(W). Naturality gives the amalgamation equations; injectivity of the localization equivalences and uniqueness of sheaf gluing give uniqueness. The zero ring and empty covers are covered by the same argument.

lean.statement:
theorem isSheafFor_principalCover_of_localizing
    (T : Scheme.{u}) (P : _root_.PresheafOfModules.{u} T.ringCatSheaf.obj)
    (W : T.affineOpens)
    (hP : ∀ a : Γ(T, W.1),
      IsLocalizedModule.Away a (P.map (homOfLE (T.basicOpen_le a)).op).hom)
    (s : Set Γ(T, W.1)) (hs : (⨆ a : s, T.basicOpen a.val) = W.val) :
    Presieve.IsSheafFor
      ((((Subtype.mono_coe T.affineOpens).functor).op ⋙ P.presheaf) ⋙
        CategoryTheory.forget AddCommGrpCat.{u})
      (Presieve.ofArrows (fun a : s ↦ T.affineBasicOpen (U := W) a.val)
        (fun a ↦ homOfLE (T.affineBasicOpen_le a.val)))
